title: Zesty Smoky Fujian Tofu Mapo Tofu
description: A paleo-friendly Chinese dish with a smoky and slightly bitter taste, featuring cacao and crunchy textures, kid-friendly and easy to make.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the smoked paprika and cacao powder and stir to combine.
Add the cubed tofu and cook until it is golden brown on all sides.
Add the sliced snow peas and cook until they are tender but still crisp.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Drizzle with sesame oil and serve immediately.
Garnish with chopped scallions or sesame seeds if desired.
